name: NotebookLM
one_liner: NotebookLM offers no official public API; programmatic access is via unofficial cookie‑based wrappers or a community Model Context Protocol server.
auth_notes: Authentication is performed using browser cookies extracted from a Google session; no API key or OAuth.
access_notes: The product is free to use, but there is no public API to obtain credentials; only unofficial wrappers exist.

evidence.snippet: An **unofficial** Node.js / TypeScript wrapper for [NotebookLM](https://notebooklm.google.com/), providing both a programmatic client library and a self-hosted REST API server.
- **Claude Code / Desktop** → the static `NOTEBOOKLM_MCP_TOKEN` bearer (an `Authorization` header).
The MCP server exposes NotebookLM to any [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)
